finalText:
Migrated 12 files (33 call sites) from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`:

| Area | Files |
|---|---|
| accounts | `admin/apiKeyAdmin.js`, `service/teamService.js`, `repo/session.js` |
| billing | `repo/refund.js`, `service/couponService.js` |
| catalog | `admin/variantAdmin.js`, `repo/supplier.js` |
| support | `admin/macroAdmin.js`, `repo/sla.js` |
| orders | `service/returnService.js`, `repo/shipment.js` |
| analytics | `repo/cohort.js` |

All files pass `node --check`. No test suite or package.json in the repo to run.

Two things I deliberately left alone:

- **`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9,13`** — still on `db.query`. Its header says it's a vendored copy of legacy-orm 2.1.4, replaced wholesale on upgrade with local edits silently lost. It'll break when the driver drops `query`; the fix belongs upstream or in a wrapper, not in the vendored file.
- **`cache.query(...)`** across ~20 repo files — that's the cache client, a different API, not part of this migration.
